purpose: Gap inventory taken BEFORE implementation (state_before) and updated AFTER (state_after / handled). Sources: docs/QAT_통합_설계_운영.md sections 13.2/13.3/17 and the QAT v1 Final Completion specification.

legend.implementable: can be completed in software without external data, credentials, a broker or a product decision
legend.external_dependency: needs something outside the repository (broker, data vendor, owner decision, real fills)
legend.handled: YES = completed and tested; PARTIAL = implemented as far as honestly possible, remainder is external; NO = intentionally not done (out of scope / blocked), with the reason

items.name: Stale snapshot policy (Reconciliation snapshot freshness)
items.state_before: NOT_IMPLEMENTED - snapshot age never judged (design 13.2; history list 'stale snapshot policy' UNKNOWN)
items.state_after: FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN from SOURCE timestamp; broker_connected policy fails closed (STALE->BLOCK, UNKNOWN->UNKNOWN); stale/unknown snapshot never attests or overwrites reconciliation; paper_replay is an explicit contract (reconciliation stays UNKNOWN, never PASS)

items.name: Persistent audit log
items.state_before: in-memory AuditLog only; UI said 'not a durable store'
items.state_after: append-only JSONL, canonical JSON, seq + prev_hash + hash chain, content_hash idempotency, fsync, verify() detects malformed/truncated/tamper/chain/seq-gap/duplicate, FAULT state refuses appends, secret scrubbing, read-only paginated API/UI; no new dependency

items.name: Strategy Health
items.state_after: HEALTHY/DEGRADED/UNHEALTHY/UNKNOWN from operational events only; no-trade is a note not a failure; never changes/disables a strategy; performance is not an input

items.name: R-07 liquidity shortage block
items.state_after: reference-bar volume vs configured minimum; NOT_CONFIGURED (null) = inert and shown as such; unknown volume -> UNKNOWN; exits not trapped when books are trusted; Kill Switch stays top-level

items.name: R-08 abnormal spread block
items.state_after: rule implemented; needs a QUOTED spread, which OHLCV bars do not have -> UNKNOWN (never PASS) while configured; UI marks it 'data not supported'. External dependency: quote / order-book data (no recorder, no vendor)

items.name: R-09 volatility shock response
items.state_after: reference-bar (high-low)/close vs configured limit; response = BLOCK of risk-increasing orders (no automatic liquidation)

items.name: MI-05 cancel/replace pattern
items.state_after: server-side per-symbol cancel history inside a rolling window vs configured limit; client cannot influence the history

items.name: MI-06 liquidity participation
items.state_after: order quantity / reference-bar volume vs configured limit; unknown volume -> UNKNOWN

items.name: Emergency flatten
items.state_before: design: 'future, separate policy'; Kill Switch never liquidates
items.state_after: explicit operator action only (operator + reason + literal FLATTEN); exposure-reducing only (never more than held, never a flip); authority token minted only by the controller; accounting-integrity / reconciliation / non-overrun breach / non-finite blockers -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED and nothing is sold; idempotent; audited; Kill Switch not released and not triggered automatically

items.name: Recovery state machine and restart assessment
items.state_after: persisted NORMAL/RECOVERY_REQUIRED/FLATTEN_SUBMITTED/FLATTENED + safety state; restart assessment FIRST_START / SAFE_RECOVERY / MANUAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED with reasons; no silent reset (corrupt latch file quarantined -> STATE_CORRUPT latch; corrupt state -> startup BLOCK); acknowledgement is an offline, audited operator action

items.name: Broker adapter boundary (interface + fake/contract adapter)
items.state_before: LiveBrokerStub that refuses everything; no adapter interface
items.state_after: contract + fake adapter + boundary implemented and contract-tested (no SDK, no credentials, no network). A REAL broker adapter is not implementable here: needs a broker choice (UNKNOWN), credentials and an approved Live design

items.name: Broker failure semantics
items.state_after: timeout / connection lost / reject / partial fill / duplicate response & callback / stale snapshot / inconsistent fill / reconnect handled at contract level; UNKNOWN order state is never terminal (reservation kept, integrity issue, no new exposure); retries idempotent by client_order_id

items.name: Paper graduation evaluator
items.state_before: criteria UNKNOWN (owner never defined); no evaluator
items.state_after: GRADUATED/NOT_READY/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN evaluator with provisional engineering thresholds; applies Protocol v2 NOT_HOLDOUT_ELIGIBLE honestly -> current result NOT_READY. External dependency: owner-defined graduation criteria, real fills for cost calibration, a real broker account for reconciliation evidence

items.name: Live readiness evaluator (Live must remain BLOCKED)
items.state_before: Live BLOCKED by router + stub; no evaluator
items.state_after: always BLOCKED; structural refusals are probed (router LIVE raises, stub refuses); no UI route or config can change it
